title: 機器學習資料版本管理
subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems
summary: 以資料版本、管線相依與訓練重現串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data versions, pipeline dependencies and training reproduction with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 來源與身份
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「來源與身份」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop origins and identity through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資料身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal folder names imply equal content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。
knowledge.textEn: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「機器學習資料版本管理」的「資料身分：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Data identity: principles and architecture” in “Machine-learning data versioning”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「資料身分」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data identity?
options: 資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料身分」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。
optionsEn: Equal folder names imply equal content.
One matching output proves data identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers.
quiz.explanation: 資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 因此「資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. The alternative "Equal folder names imply equal content." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料身分：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料身分」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」；將結果與「資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Compare results against: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal folder names imply equal content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料身分」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal folder names imply equal content.

quiz.question: 審查「資料清單」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data manifests?
options: 清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。
只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料清單」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions.
Total size alone reproduces a version.
One matching output proves data manifests for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。 讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。 因此「只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions. Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. The alternative "Total size alone reproduces a version." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料清單：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料清單」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data manifests.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。」；將結果與「清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. Compare results against: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Total size alone reproduces a version. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料清單」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data manifests; explain why this claim fails: Total size alone reproduces a version.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for data manifests?
options: 只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。

steps.title: 許可用途：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「許可用途」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for license purposes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「許可用途」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：訓練與公開散佈可能需要不同授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製和官方連結分別記錄允許用途。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for license purposes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Training and redistribution may need different permissions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record separate permissions for self-made files and links. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 為自製和官方連結分別記錄允許用途。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record separate permissions for self-made files and links. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：能下載就能重發所有資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Downloadability permits redistribution of all data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「許可用途」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「為自製和官方連結分別記錄允許用途。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for license purposes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
